name: Niiyama Miyabi
source:
The school's top scholar and student council president. Her goal is to become president.

Truthfully, she's a hard worker, but sadly, her life boils down to three choices: Fall so far she becomes a stripper in a seedy bar, Or awaken a different talent and become a Queen Pop Star.

Julia is her best friend, but also her greatest rival.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/senpai/chara/chara.htmll] official site[/url]]
